summary: Bounded positive audit of main hypotheses, regularized compactness, self-convolution/CLT, ordered regularization limits, Gaussian coercivity, even envelopes, sharp Gaussian matrix constant and application ranges. Independent trace/determinant certificate verifies the sharp constant and Gaussian equality without assuming attainment. No substantive mathematical defect confirmed.

independent_verification.scope: Focused independent acceptance of existing reported problems; bounded scope review for No Issue Found. No whole-paper certification.

scientific_facts.scope: No Issue Found: independent check of report scope/limitations and selected decisive positive calculations, rather than a new whole-paper audit.
scientific_facts.outcome: Retain No confirmed substantive issue within the inspected scope; no scientific report correction required.

checks.reason: The report retains positive c_i, orthogonal coordinate block projections, nonnegative even integrable inputs, and the log-concavity required for the inverse statement. It does not claim arbitrary linear maps, negative weights, a finite Gaussian supremum in every case, or classification of all functional equality cases.

checks.source_locations: Publisher PDF p.33; report sharp Gaussian constant section
checks.reason: With B_i=A_i^(-1/2), testing the stated PSD block matrix on x_i=B_i z and tracing gives sum_(i!=j)Tr(B_i B_j)<=mn(m-1). Each B_i B_j is similar to a positive definite matrix, so Tr(B_i B_j)>=n+log det(B_i B_j). Summation yields sum_i log det A_i>=0. A_i=I attains the bound with a permitted semidefinite full block matrix. No commutativity or prior compact attainment is assumed. For m>=3 the equality constraints force all A_i=I; m=2 allows reciprocal matrices.

The finite list of audited proof interfaces is distinguished from full reproof of cited central-limit/transport results, the nonsmooth affine-surface-area adaptation and exhaustive bibliography/equality analysis. These limits support a bounded no-issue conclusion. The former pending independent-acceptance wording is coordinated with the present facts.

limitations: No certification that every argument or external reference in the paper is correct.
No new exhaustive literature search, external CLT/transport proof reconstruction, or nonsmooth affine-surface-area proof.
Conclusion applies to the supplied publisher PDF only; optional sources are not assumed equivalent.
